verificationSummary: Editor commit a007817b0f21de758e93a7c0b63873ca0414d5a7 adds the bounded dev:local-loopback runner and dev:local-loopback:smoke command. The runner treats Core as dependency-only, starts Backend as a local loopback server process, starts Editor as a Vite dev server with VITE_FLOWDOC_BACKEND_URL pointed at Backend, waits for Backend /health and Editor /documents, and writes no evidence fixtures. RED failed before implementation because scripts/run-local-loopback-dev.mjs did not exist; focused GREEN passed src/tests/localLoopbackDevRunner.test.ts with 1 test. npm run dev:local-loopback:smoke passed by starting Backend and Editor on random loopback ports and exiting after readiness. Editor worktree npm run check passed type-check, 84 passed test files, 292 passed tests, and build; merged Editor main npm run check also passed type-check, 84 passed test files, 292 passed tests, and build. Editor npm install reported 5 high severity vulnerabilities and Vite retained the existing chunk-size warning; Core local checkout had unrelated deleted pdf-renderer-pilot fixture files and was not edited. This evidence supports only the local loopback dev runner, is local loopback only, and does not promote FlowDoc, Editor, Backend, Core, deployed compatibility, cross-browser behavior, accessibility readiness, visual regression readiness, durable storage readiness, PDF export readiness, npm audit remediation, bundle-size readiness, or product readiness.
